## Character or change

Describe the ball, skill, or improvement. For a new ball, include its folder and namespaced ID.

## Behavior

List its skills (maximum three), triggers, and timings. Include a screenshot or short recording when the appearance or behavior changes.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Character contributions should pass `npm run validate:content`, `npm test`, and `npm run build`. UI, effect, or recording changes should also pass `npm run test:e2e`.

## Artwork and credits

For new media, identify the source, author, and license in the character pack.
